headline: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson to be sentenced for child sexual abuse – latest updates

members.title: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson to be sentenced for child sexual abuse – latest updates
members.lead: Donaldson has been found guilty of 18 counts of sexual abuse against two women when they were children The DUP has disowned its former leader and condemned his crimes but faced a backlash from supporters amid allegations the party turned a blind eye to other misbehaviour by Donaldson, including drunkenness and sexual harassment. The jury in the four-week trial found that his wife, Eleanor, aided and abetted her husband’s offending. The 60-year-old was deemed unfit to stand trial on mental health grounds and faced a trial of the facts, which tests evidence but does not result in a criminal conviction. Continue reading...

members.title: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson sentenced to 15 years for child sexual offences
members.lead: Donaldson was found guilty in June of 18 counts of sexual abuse including one rape between 1985 and 2008 Jeffrey Donaldson has been sentenced to 15 years for sexual offences against two women who were children when he abused them, completing what was described as a “catastrophic descent into disgrace”. The sentence at Newry crown court on Thursday sealed the downfall of a former Democratic Unionist party (DUP) leader who once dominated unionism in Northern Ireland. Continue reading...
